messages.speaker: Cinder
messages.text: Cinder here. We should each try to build shelters — it reduces living costs. Let's coordinate on gathering wood.

messages.speaker: Lumen
messages.text: I'm going to gather wood twice and build a shelter this cycle. If anyone wants to coordinate, let me know!

messages.speaker: Aster
messages.text: I'm gathering wood to build shelter. Please leave some wood for me.

messages.text: Wood is gone for this cycle (0 available). Let's focus on foraging food to survive.

messages.text: Wood is at 0 right now — nobody can gather until it regrows after the cycle. I'll keep foraging so we have food reserves. Let's all stock food this cycle and build shelters next cycle when wood returns.

messages.speaker: Cinder
messages.text: The land is out of wood this cycle, so I'm foraging food. Next cycle let's coordinate wood gathering so we can each build shelters.

messages.text: No wood left on the land, so I'm foraging food this chance. I have 2 wood already — if anyone else gathers wood, let's pool toward a shelter for one of us first.

messages.text: Resting now to save energy. I have 3 food stocked. Next cycle wood regrows — let's all gather wood early and pool for shelters. Lumen already has 2 wood, great start.
